traits.name: Volume and parallelism
traits.meaning: Agents generate far more change volume than humans, in parallel, around the clock. A review system sized for human pull request rates will drown.
traits.state_note: Proven for agent build volume in the overnight run and for lead scoring volume in the 2026-09-16 hunt job. Not yet proven against real pull request volume through a review queue; that part is DESIGNED.
traits.design_consequence: Review must be per change packet, not per comment thread, and must run without a human in the per-packet path. Volume is absorbed by parallel isolated reviewers and a deterministic gate, not by adding human reviewers.

evidence.fact: Wave 1 audit checked 143 hub cards in about 5 minutes using 4 parallel audit agents (00:56 to about 01:01 EST).
Waves ran 4 to 5 agents in parallel through the night (00:56 to about 05:55 EST); Wave 2 fixed 17 items in about 15 minutes; meme batches rendered 48, 22, 20, 20 and 20 images in single batches.
LANDOS hunt job 6071b7ad scored 153 leads and synchronized 153 leads to CRM in one run.

traits.name: No persistent memory across sessions
traits.meaning: Agents forget between sessions. The system must remember for them. The receipt chain is the memory.
traits.state_note: Proven that the estate loses context without written receipts (IDENTITY section 19) and that chained receipts survive as memory (Done Ledger chain VALID, 118 receipts). The receipt chain as the sole memory for source control review is IMPLEMENTED in the demo, not yet proven on real reviews.
traits.design_consequence: Every consequential action writes a hash-chained receipt before it counts. Nothing is trusted to an agent's session memory. The chain, not the agent, carries state forward.

evidence.fact: Section 19 names context loss as the estate's central problem, listing stale documentation, duplicated work, forgotten receipts, unclear canonical sources and repeated archaeology.
Memory Gate decay rule recorded as F(t)=2^(-t/h); patches that worked become memory, patches that failed become negative lessons, with decay and quarantine.

Done/Open Ledger holds 118 items (Done 43, Open 65, Unknown 7, In flight 3) with 118 v1.1 receipts chained from GENESIS, chain head 76675cc07b629bbea8b76717e282fdb89d05d519953562e22aa75a134666dcad, CHAIN VALID in Python and JS.
Decisions D-005 to D-008 were recorded in writing by the overnight coordinator because they would otherwise be lost; the log states they are builder decisions, not Jeramie's orders.

traits.name: Need machine-readable verdicts, not prose
traits.meaning: Agents cannot read threads. A verdict must be a value a machine can act on, with the exact failing claims named.
traits.state_note: Implemented as a browser simulation in the phase 1 demo. No real pull request has been reviewed by this verdict format, so it is not PROVEN.
traits.design_consequence: Review output is a verdict enum plus a list of exact failing claims, never a comment thread. The change packet carries the diff, the N-Cell/64 authority header, the claim set and the evidence in one machine-readable unit.

evidence.fact: CRUCIBLE eta verdict: eta = (I_q * I_r * I_v) / (1 + E_wasted + C_violations), clamped 0-100, threshold 70. PASS needs eta at or above 70 AND uncited count zero.
CRUCIBLE: uncited claims returned by exact text. PASS publishes, FLAG returns the claims to fix.
N-Cell/64 header is 8 bytes: routeMask, organMask, lifecycleMask, authorityMask, memoryMask, confidence, risk, outputMask.
Complaint table: threads become overwhelming and unreadable quickly; the estate answer is seven-agent isolated review, one verdict per agent, one adjudicated outcome.

traits.name: Correlated errors and phantom consensus
traits.meaning: Agents converge on each other's errors. Agreement after interaction is not independent confirmation. Isolated parallel review exists to stop that.
traits.state_note: The isolation mechanism is implemented as a simulation. The phantom-consensus measurement itself is unproven in the estate: 0 resolved forecasts exist to score against, so no private vs post-interaction gap has ever been measured. See blocked seam S10.
traits.design_consequence: Review runs in isolation first, then deliberation, then a Chair. Private verdicts are logged before any interaction so the private vs post-interaction gap can be measured. Agreement is composed by dependence-aware pooling weighted by per-agent Brier scores, never by majority vote.

evidence.fact: Grok consensus advice pasted 2026-11-15: failure modes named are correlated errors, phantom consensus and uncalibrated aggregation. New specifics: composed probability by scaled log-odds or dependence-aware pooling, phantom-consensus measurement as the gap between private findings and post-interaction findings, structured abstain, per-plugin reliability, debate limit, public eval set.
Sentinel Court attack surface: swarms, 20 identical workers are not 20 independent confirmations.
Organization Compiler: swarm diversity enforced, 20 identical agents are not 20 independent opinions; Bayesian reliability per worker per task family.
Each review agent reads only the packet, in isolation. No agent reads another agent's output. Confidence is seeded by a deterministic hash of the packet text plus the lens name.

traits.name: Need explicit authority
traits.meaning: AI generates, founder authorizes, system executes (G-1). Agents do not self-authorize. Every proposed action carries who authorized it, the scope, the expiry and a single-use token.
traits.state_note: Proven in real test code (91/91, including 29/29 authority and gate checks). Live enforcement against a real repo host is not built; credential provisioning is BLOCKED (seam S1).
traits.design_consequence: No packet reaches review without a valid authority header. The gate is deterministic and independent of the scoring function. A merge is an external action, so it always needs founder approval; the system prepares the packet, it cannot send it.

evidence.fact: Layer 3: every proposed action must carry an authority header stating who or what authorized it, the scope, the expiry and the single-use token or equivalent. The policy gate can DENY or ESCALATE independently of the model. Human approval remains mandatory for any action that leaves the system or affects external state.

run_tests.py 91/91. Authority and gate section 29/29: export without header DENIED, expired header DENIED, revoked token DENIED, token reuse DENIED, export without human approval DENIED, approved_by=system DENIED, model approval cannot override DENY.
Layer 3 authority: authorizer, scope, expiry, 256-bit single-use token, deterministic DENY/ESCALATE gate, revocation list, gate receipt chain verifies (17 receipts).

traits.name: Produce unverified claims unless gated
traits.meaning: Agents state claims as fact. Nothing promotes on a claim alone. Promotion needs a passing gate plus a real external signal, and provisional machine decisions stay provisional.
traits.state_note: Proven that the gate rejects in a real run (retardio run 3) and that ungated claims were found and corrected in the overnight audit. The canonical promotion rule is not settled: D-006 records two demos with different rules, so the rule itself is a blocked seam (S9).
traits.design_consequence: The eta gate, the CRUCIBLE verdict and the promotion gate sit in the promotion path, not beside it. A failed gate blocks promotion by default. Every gate decision is receipted, including rejections.

evidence.fact: Proof run 3: baseline_v2 proposed through the gate and REJECTED (resolved 0 below the 200 threshold; Brier NOT YET COMPUTABLE). Rejection receipted, rule stays baseline_v1.

Governance Loop: only a claim that passes all three gates AND carries a real external signal promotes. P0 Seam: KILL below 20 or 3 strikes, ITERATE 20-49, SHIP-CANDIDATE at or above 50 only with a real external signal.

D-005 to D-008 are provisional machine decisions, recorded as builder decisions, not canon, until Jeramie adopts them. D-006 records that the unified chain promotion rule differs from the governance-loop demo rule.
Wave 1 audit found 12 unproven-claim cards and 12 stale cards across 143 checked; the fix wave relabeled LIVE tags on 11 simulation cards to SIMULATION or DEMO.

traits.name: Need dedup
traits.meaning: Recursion without dedup re-issues the same work. A loop that cannot tell new from seen will flood the review queue with repeats.
traits.state_note: Proven in the real Retardio loop across 6 runs. Not yet proven in a review queue; no real pull request volume has run through this dedup.
traits.design_consequence: Every packet and every observation is deduped by content hash (observation_id is SHA-256 of canonical payload) against persistent state before review starts. A repeat packet is a no-op with a receipt, not a second review.

evidence.fact: Proof run 2 fetched 25 observations (0 new) and issued 0 new forecasts. Proves recursion plus dedup: run 2 read run 1 state and continued from it.
Run 6 (2026-11-16T12:23:16Z) fetched 25, 0 new, 0 new forecasts, status OK. Six runs total, 20 forecasts, zero duplicate forecasts for any observation_id.
PR volume strain answer cites the Retardio loop dedup proof, and states plainly that dedup is proven only in the Retardio loop, not in a review queue.

traits.name: Stateless sessions, stateful system
traits.meaning: The agent session holds nothing durable. All durable state lives in the receipt chain and the state file the loop reads and continues.
traits.state_note: Proven in the real loop: 6 runs continued from shared state, chain head advanced, verifier reports CHAIN VALID. The source-control application of this pattern is IMPLEMENTED in the demo only.
traits.design_consequence: State is a file plus a chain, never a session. A new agent session starts by reading the chain head and the state file. If the chain does not verify, the session does not proceed.

evidence.fact: state.json is read and continued by every run, never reset. Receipts are canonical v1.1, GENESIS-chained. Verifier is a standalone offline reimplementation, so the check is not circular.
After run 6: run_count 6, receipt_count 17, receipt chain head fc64c10c73ce3e528135701e2dc9befa18d8ac82c4b68f3466fd0102d462aa23, rule baseline_v1 unchanged, Brier NOT YET COMPUTABLE.
Anchor v2: 235 leaves, root afd56cea3e4abe9265f83c3552cddebac2771ab6d5d50012a641695fd8b8777f, verified identically in Python and JavaScript; tamper harness 8/8 attacks detected.

traits.name: Human traits in the loop
traits.meaning: The founder is the source of intent and consequential authority. The human is the authorizer and exception handler, not the typist.
traits.state_note: Proven that the gate enforces human approval in real test code (91/91). The production exception-handler workflow for source control is DESIGNED, not yet run, because no live promotion service exists (seam S6).
traits.design_consequence: The human appears at exactly three points: intent (the mission), authorization (the gate), and exception (escalation, quarantine override, rollback decision). Everything between those points is machine work with receipts.

evidence.fact: Layer 3: human approval remains mandatory for any action that leaves the system or affects external state. The system can prepare the packet; it cannot send it.

Gate test 53i: export without human approval DENIED. Gate test 53j: approved_by=system DENIED. Gate test 54: probability at or above 0.80 escalates, escalation queued with receipt attached, human holds escalation.
Section 19: the estate is larger than one human's continuously maintained mental model, which is why the human cannot be the typist for every change and must instead be the authorizer.
Cockpit: the human-accountable surface for declaring intent, inspecting evidence, assigning resources, approving consequential action, monitoring execution, reviewing outcomes.

stages.note: The packet is the claim. Diff, header, claim set and evidence travel as one unit.

Evidence attached to claims, in the packet.

contract.decision_rule: Dedup first, by content hash. observation_id in the real loop is SHA-256 of the canonical payload only (~/workspace/onchain-anchor/observation.py). A repeat packet is a no-op with a receipt, not a second review. Dedup is PROVEN in the Retardio loop (run 2 fetched 25, 0 new, 0 new forecasts) and NOT proven in a review queue. No packet-size, claim-count, or file-count limit is on record, so those limits are UNDEFINED. Contract check (convergence item 94, ~/workspace/convergence-100/contract.py check_message): reject unknown module, unaccepted message type, missing payload field, or missing authority where required.

output_schema.note: SHA-256 of the canonical packet payload.
Pasted diff summary, as supplied.
Stamped at stage 2, carried in the packet from here on.
Claim set with sources, as supplied.
Evidence, as supplied.

contract.failure_behavior: Fail closed. Empty diff, empty claim set, or a failed contract check stops the walk here. No packet_id is issued. A v1.1 gate receipt is written (action gate, decision REJECTED, payload holds stage 1, reason, and input hash, not a fabricated packet). The operator sees: packet rejected at compose, reason named, no review started.

stages.name: Stamp authority
stages.unified_chain: Unified chain stage 2, N-Cell/64 header stamp
stages.note: Authorizer, scope, expiry, 256-bit single-use token. No header, no review.

input_schema.note: Output of stage 1.
Who authorizes. Human approval is mandatory for any action that leaves the system (six-layer spec Layer 3).
Non-empty. Empty scope is a DENY.
Must be in the future. Expired header is a DENY.
Single use. Reuse is a DENY. Revoked token is a DENY.

contract.decision_rule: Stamp the N-Cell/64 header: 8 bytes in order routeMask, organMask, lifecycleMask, authorityMask, memoryMask, confidence, risk, outputMask (~/workspace/unified-chain/unified-chain.js stampHeader). Defaults in that file are confidence 128, organMask 0x07, every other byte 0. The worked example in that file is routeMask 0x1f, organMask 0x07, lifecycleMask 0x01, authorityMask 0x07, memoryMask 0x0f, confidence 165, risk 45, outputMask 0x01, hex 1F 07 01 07 0F A5 2D 01. The phase 1 demo derives confidence from eta and risk from blast-radius words in the diff summary; that derivation is demo-specific, not canonical. Rule: no header, no review. Header present and valid is ALLOW to stage 3; missing or invalid header is DENY.

output_schema.note: In byte order above.
Uppercase hex, space separated, for example 1F 07 01 07 0F A5 2D 01.
Stage 1 packet plus header_bytes and header_hex.

contract.failure_behavior: Fail closed. Missing authorizer, empty scope, expired expiry, empty token, token reuse, or revoked token gives DENY. A v1.1 gate receipt is written (action gate, decision DENIED, payload holds stage 2 and the exact failing check). The walk stops. The operator sees: authorization denied, failing check named, packet does not enter review.

stages.name: Authorize and intersect
stages.note: Proposed intersected against allowed and available. Identity is BLOCKED, so this stage runs on the header alone in the demo.

input_schema.note: Output of stage 2.
E_proposed.
E_allowed.
E_available.

contract.decision_rule: Governance intersection from ~/workspace/unified-chain/unified-chain.js governanceIntersection: E* equals E_proposed intersect E_allowed intersect E_available. Verdicts, exact: NO PROPOSAL when proposed is empty; BLOCKED when the intersection is empty; PARTIAL when the intersection is non-empty but smaller than proposed; PROCEED only when the intersection equals proposed. Default sets in that file (decision D-001, provisional): propose 8 edges, allow 6, available 5, intersection 5, verdict PARTIAL, which blocks promotion. Identity is BLOCKED (seam S1, edges E04 and E05 BLOCKED): no live identity provider is wired in, so in the demo this stage runs on the header alone. Header-only authorization is NOT proven identity. That is a gap, not a pass.

output_schema.note: E*, sorted, unique.
Proposed edges missing from E_allowed.
Proposed edges allowed but missing from E_available.

output_schema.type: object {proposed, allowed, available, intersection, blockedPolicy, blockedInfra: integer}
output_schema.note: Counts from intersectionDetail in unified-chain.js.

output_schema.type: string, one of NO PROPOSAL, BLOCKED, PARTIAL, PROCEED
output_schema.note: Exact verdict.

contract.failure_behavior: Fail closed. NO PROPOSAL, BLOCKED, or PARTIAL stops the walk. A v1.1 gate receipt is written (action gate, decision DENIED or STOPPED, payload holds stage 3, verdict, blocked_policy, blocked_infra). The operator sees: intersection verdict named, blocked edges listed by id, packet does not enter review. Identity BLOCKED is also recorded on the receipt, so a header-only pass is never presented as identity-verified.

stages.name: Isolated review
stages.unified_chain: No unified chain match. New stage.
stages.note: No unified chain match. New stage. Seven lenses read only the packet, in isolation. Diff Engine and CI Runner are BLOCKED, so reviewers read pasted packets in the demo.

input_schema.note: Output of stage 3, verdict PROCEED.

input_schema.type: array of object {file: string, function: string, blast_radius: string}
input_schema.note: BLOCKED. Diff Engine does not exist (seam S2). In the demo reviewers read the pasted packet only.
BLOCKED. CI Runner does not exist (seam S3). No test, lint, type-check, or security-scan result is produced. The eta inputs that CI would feed are entered by hand in the demo.

contract.decision_rule: Seven lenses read only the packet, in isolation: Hawkins Correctness, Orwell Security, Keystone Test Coverage, Advocate Blast Radius, Cicero Style/Consistency, Zeitgeist Documentation, Empath Risk. No agent reads another agent output. Confidence is seeded by a deterministic hash of the packet text plus the lens name (topology-data.json, T4 evidence). Per-lens verdict enum values are NOT on record, so they are UNDEFINED here; do not invent them. The debate limit is a short challenge round (Grok advice in the daybreak map); no round count is on record, so the count is UNDEFINED. Contract check (item 94) applies at entry: a message the review-swarm module does not accept, or a payload missing required fields, is rejected before any lens runs.

output_schema.type: array of 7 objects, one per lens {lens: string, verdict: UNDEFINED enum, confidence: number, claims_checked: array}
output_schema.note: Private verdicts, logged to the Receipt Chain BEFORE deliberation (edge E32).
Receipt ids for the seven logged private verdicts.

contract.failure_behavior: Fail closed. A failed contract check, a missing packet, or a lens that cannot run stops the walk. A v1.1 gate receipt is written (action gate, decision STOPPED, payload holds stage 4 and the failing check). The operator sees: review stopped, failing lens or check named, no verdict issued. If diff hunks or CI signals are absent, the walk does NOT claim a full review: the verdict is labeled SIMULATION, pasted-packet only, and the missing inputs are named on the receipt.

stages.note: No unified chain match. New stage. Challenge only conflicting claims, then one adjudicated outcome.

contract.decision_rule: Deliberation challenges only conflicting claims, per the debate limit. The Chair then produces one adjudicated outcome. Agreement is composed by dependence-aware pooling weighted by per-agent Brier scores, never by majority vote (T4 design consequence). Per-agent Brier weights cannot be computed in the estate today: 0 resolved forecasts exist, so the weights are UNDEFINED and the pooling is DESIGNED, not PROVEN (seam S10). The adjudicated outcome enum values are NOT on record, so they are UNDEFINED here.

contract.failure_behavior: Fail closed. If the seven private verdicts are missing, or were not logged before deliberation, the Chair does not adjudicate. A v1.1 gate receipt is written (action gate, decision STOPPED, payload holds stage 5 and the missing input). The operator sees: deliberation stopped, private verdicts missing or unlogged, no adjudicated outcome. The walk does not proceed to CRUCIBLE on an unlogged review.

stages.name: CRUCIBLE verdict
stages.note: Eta at or above 70 and zero uncited claims passes. Sentinel Court is the independent check on the verdict.

input_schema.note: Output of stage 5.

input_schema.type: array of object {claim_text: string, source: string}
input_schema.note: Claims with sources.
Quality.
Relevance.
Verification.
Wasted effort.
Constraint violations.

Used only by etaGate in unified-chain.js; seed_allowed needs 0.6 or above. No feedback accuracy value is recorded for source control review, so it is UNDEFINED for this stage unless a caller supplies one.

contract.decision_rule: Eta formula, exact: eta equals (I_q times I_r times I_v) divided by (1 plus E_wasted plus C_violations), clamped to 0-100, threshold 70. PASS needs eta at or above 70 AND uncited count zero, where uncited count is the number of claims with an empty source field. Prefill fact, verified: inputs I_q 88, I_r 90, I_v 85, E_wasted 1, C_violations 0 give raw 336600, clamped to 100, not 78. The demo pages show raw and capped. CRUCIBLE score bands in unified-chain.js crucibleVerdict are separate and also apply where that function is used: score equals max(0, emergence_raw minus objection_penalty) times signal multiplier (contract 1.00, pilot 0.50, lead 0.30, none 0.15); KILL below 20, ITERATE 20-49, SHIP-CANDIDATE at or above 50 only with a real external signal, else ITERATE. EtaGate seed_allowed needs eta at or above 70 AND feedback_accuracy at or above 0.6. Sentinel Court is the independent check on the verdict (edges E26, E27, SIMULATED); no independent verifier service exists, so its confirm or veto is SIMULATED, not a live second opinion.

input_schema.type: object {memoryClass, source, freshness, evidence, contradiction, relevanceHorizon, kind, mutability}
input_schema.note: Eight gate questions from unified-chain.js evaluateWrite. memoryClass is one of Working, Episodic, Semantic, Procedural, Negative, Strategic, Capability, Epistemic. freshness is one of Minutes, Hours, Days, Weeks, Months, Years. evidence is a number 0-10. contradiction is one of none, contradicts, supersedes. kind is Fact or Inference. mutability is Immutable history or Editable current state.

contract.decision_rule: Canonical v1.1 receipt (~/workspace/onchain-anchor/receipt-schema.json, version 1.1): receipt_version 1.1, receipt_id equals receipt_hash, receipt_hash is SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the receipt with receipt_hash and receipt_id removed, canonical JSON is keys sorted bytewise, separators comma and colon, no whitespace, UTF-8. Required fields: receipt_version, receipt_id, receipt_hash, prev_hash, action (one of observation, forecast, outcome, gate, promotion, verification, anchor, build), actor, timestamp ISO 8601 UTC, merkle_root, anchor_root, payload. anchor_root is null until a real anchor exists (seam S7, criterion 2 BLOCKED). merkle_root is the Anchor v2 full root afd56cea3e4abe9265f83c3552cddebac2771ab6d5d50012a641695fd8b8777f over 235 leaves, or null only when no manifest exists. Note the shape difference: ~/workspace/unified-chain/unified-chain.js is receipt v1.0, with provenance.report_hash_sha256 and provenance.prev_receipt_hash. The v1.1 shape above is canonical for new receipts; do not mix the two field names. Memory write-gate (evaluateWrite): evidence below 3 is REJECT, evidence below 6 is QUARANTINE, contradiction contradicts is QUARANTINE, else WRITE. Those thresholds are ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY: the JGI paper gives no numeric thresholds. Decay for retained memory is F(t) equals 2 to the power of minus t over h, t and h in days, with presets runtime 0.0167, repo 0.5, lead 7, strategy 30, historical 365 days.

contract.failure_behavior: Fail closed. An invalid gate input gives REJECT and no write. A hash mismatch on verify, a broken prev_hash link, or a first receipt whose prev_hash is not GENESIS gives CHAIN BROKEN and no state advance. The operator sees: receipt rejected or chain broken, receipt index and error named, walk stops. The ledger is never rewritten to hide a failure; a correction is a new receipt, not an edit.

contract.decision_rule: Two promotion rules are on record and they differ (seam S9, overnight decision D-006, provisional). Unified chain rule (decidePromotionUnified in unified-chain.js): PROCEED only when intersection is PROCEED AND CRUCIBLE verdict is not KILL AND memory write-gate is WRITE, or QUARANTINE with an explicit override noted on the record. Every other combination is STOP and names each blocking gate. Governance-loop rule (daybreak map): SHIP-CANDIDATE plus a real external signal is also required; an ITERATE crucible can promote under the unified rule and not under the governance-loop rule. Promotion gate function in unified-chain.js (promotionGate): promote only when verdict is SHIP-CANDIDATE AND external_signal is true. Canonical rule: UNDEFINED. It is a founder decision, pending (seam S9). Fail-closed tie-break, stated here and not a founder order: when the two recorded rules disagree, do NOT promote. Convergence-100 gate (items 46-47, run_tests.py 91/91, 29/29 authority and gate): export without header DENIED, expired header DENIED, revoked token DENIED, token reuse DENIED, export without human approval DENIED, approved_by system DENIED, model approval cannot override DENY. Probability at or above 0.80 escalates, escalation queued with receipt attached, human holds escalation (gate test 54).

The operator sees: promotion refused, blocking gates listed, packet stays unpromoted, no merge attempted. A rejection receipt is not a failure of the system; it is the gate working.

contract.decision_rule: Outcome coding: the merge outcome is coded against the original claims and forecasts, and appended as an outcome receipt chained onto the same ledger (ingestOutcome and recordOutcome in unified-chain.js). Rollback: a merge failure or bad promotion signal triggers rollback (edge E20, SIMULATED). A rollback is itself a chained receipt, not a deletion (phase 1 demo rollback control). Strike counting (applyStrike): a KILL adds one strike; kill_move fires only at strike 3; the first KILL does not move the file; non-KILL verdicts do not add strikes. Outcome resolution is BLOCKED (seam S8): the Retardio loop has 20 forecasts, 0 resolved, Brier NOT YET COMPUTABLE. The assessor source carries only the latest sale per parcel, no grantor, no deed history, no formation dates. For source control, the equivalent is real merge outcomes recorded in the Outcome Ledger over time; none exist yet.

contract.decision_rule: Rule change proposals go through the promotion gate. A proposal is accepted ONLY if Brier improves on held-out data AND resolved is at least 200 (retardio loop gate; convergence item 62 held-out split is deterministic by hash, disjoint by construction, and refuses on an empty set). Proof: baseline_v2 was proposed in retardio run 3 and REJECTED (resolved 0 below 200, Brier NOT YET COMPUTABLE); the rejection was receipted and the rule stays baseline_v1. The loop never self-proposes. Next mission (nextMission in unified-chain.js): a success queues a follow-up claim pre-filled into stage 1; a failure queues a rework claim naming what failed. The card is a suggestion, not an execution. Contract check (item 94): a promotion_proposal message needs a valid authority header; without it, check_message returns authority-required and the proposal is rejected. Latency (item 95): the disposition records a live measurement of 863.7 ms total (fetch 863.3 ms, canonicalize plus hash 0.2 ms, forecast plus receipt 0.1 ms) against the public ArcGIS endpoint. The latency.json file on disk records a different run at 1236.4 ms total (fetch 1236.2 ms, canonicalize 0.2 ms, forecast 0.1 ms). Both numbers are reported here as recorded; they are two different runs, not one number. No latency budget or threshold is on record, so the budget is UNDEFINED. Kill switch: if a KILL file exists, halt before fetching, append a halt receipt, log, exit 0 (retardio run 4 halted, run 5 re-armed).

output_schema.type: object, canonical v1.1, action gate or promotion
output_schema.note: Accepted false with reasons when rejected; accepted only on the held-out Brier rule above.

output_schema.type: object {kind: follow-up or rework, claim: string, notes: string}

Updated guidance to Agent Workers when a rule change is accepted; null while baseline_v1 stands.

contract.failure_behavior: Fail closed. With 0 resolved, Brier is NOT YET COMPUTABLE, no promotion is accepted, and the rule stays baseline_v1. A proposal without a valid authority header is rejected by the contract check. A KILL file halts the loop before any fetch. A v1.1 receipt is written for a rejection, a halt, and a re-arm. The operator sees: proposal rejected with the resolved count and Brier status named, or loop halted on KILL, with the receipt id. The loop closes only when learning produces the next packet through stage 1; until then it waits, it does not invent outcomes.

blocked_seams.name: Identity
blocked_seams.what_is_blocked: No live identity provider. Who the agent is, who authorizes, what scope, what expiry. Provisioning, key management and revocation that works when a key leaks are not built.
blocked_seams.what_unblocks_it: A real identity provider wired to the N-Cell header and gate, with provisioning, rotation and a working revocation list.
blocked_seams.whose_decision: Jeramie: pick the identity approach and fund the build. Order of work in the resolution doc puts identity first, before diff engine, CI, transport, hosting and the live promotion service.

blocked_seams.name: Diff engine
blocked_seams.what_is_blocked: No real diff engine. The demo reviews pasted packets, not real diffs from a real repo. Hunks are not mapped to files, functions or blast radius.
blocked_seams.what_unblocks_it: A parser plus a language-aware layer that maps real diffs to files, functions and blast radius and feeds the review swarm.
blocked_seams.whose_decision: Jeramie: product direction call on whether this graduates from simulation toward a real transport (resolution doc section 7, item 3).

blocked_seams.name: CI runner
blocked_seams.what_is_blocked: No real CI. Tests, lint, type checks and security scans do not run against the change in an isolated runner. The eta formula exists; the signals that feed it do not, except by hand.
blocked_seams.what_unblocks_it: Runner infrastructure plus result ingestion into the CRUCIBLE eta verdict.
blocked_seams.whose_decision: Jeramie: same graduation call as S2.

blocked_seams.name: Git transport
blocked_seams.what_is_blocked: No real git transport. No clone, fetch, push, refs or packfiles. Without this there is no source control product, only a review page.
blocked_seams.what_unblocks_it: Either implement git hosting or wrap an existing git server and accept its limits. Largest single build of the six gaps.
blocked_seams.whose_decision: Jeramie: same graduation call as S2.

blocked_seams.name: Repo hosting
blocked_seams.what_is_blocked: No repo hosting. Storage, access control, webhooks and uptime for real repos are not built. GitHub Pages hosts demos free; hosting real repos is a different commitment.
blocked_seams.what_unblocks_it: Hosting infrastructure and operations, or an accepted dependency on an existing host with its limits stated.
blocked_seams.whose_decision: Jeramie: same graduation call as S2.

blocked_seams.name: Live promotion service
blocked_seams.what_is_blocked: No live promotion service. The promotion gate exists only as a demo control and as gate code in convergence-100. The unified-chain demo is not a service with a database, a queue and an operator.
blocked_seams.what_unblocks_it: Turn the unified-chain demo into a service: database, queue, operator, automatic rollback, Sentinel Court as independent verifier. The Retardio loop is the only live proof this pattern runs unattended, once a day on public data.
blocked_seams.whose_decision: Jeramie: same graduation call as S2.

blocked_seams.name: On-chain anchor write
blocked_seams.what_is_blocked: Anchor v2 criterion 2, actual chain write, is BLOCKED. The execution path is built (ots_anchor.sh, Solana memo template, Base/Polygon calldata templates, human approval gate). No chain write, no wallet, no spending.

blocked_seams.name: Outcome resolution
blocked_seams.what_is_blocked: Learning cannot score anything until outcomes resolve. The Retardio loop has 20 forecasts, 0 resolved, Brier NOT YET COMPUTABLE. The assessor source carries only the latest sale per parcel, no grantor, no deed history, no formation dates.
blocked_seams.what_unblocks_it: Recorder bulk data or per-parcel record cards for deed history, plus Secretary of State formation dates. For source control, the equivalent is real merge outcomes recorded in the Outcome Ledger over time.

blocked_seams.name: Canonical promotion rule conflict

The unified chain promotes when intersection is PROCEED, CRUCIBLE is not KILL, and write-gate is WRITE or QUARANTINE with explicit override. The governance-loop demo additionally requires SHIP-CANDIDATE plus a real external signal. An ITERATE crucible can promote in one and not the other.
